snippet.title: Largely Legal Monstrosity Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Largely Legal Monstrosity is an incremental bullet heaven with optional auto-aim. Survive, consume, and grow. Craft your build in a race to disrupt the market leader. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history! 

"A cynical soulless cash grab without a single original thought or idea in it. I guess art really does imitate life." 
- Theodore Roosevelt… according to the monstrosity at least.

Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4951860/Largely_Legal_Monstrosity

#indiegames #bullethell #indiedev #gaming
